questions.question: The correct heading wording for this statement is:
options: For the year ended 28 February — it covers a period, not a moment

questions.question: Gross operating income of R880 000 is made up of:
options: Gross profit of R820 000 plus other operating income of R60 000

questions.question: Operating profit of R439 000 less interest expense of R18 000 gives:
options: Net profit for the year of R421 000

questions.question: Partners' salaries and interest on capital are absent from this statement because:
options: They are too small to show
They belong in the trading account
They are appropriations of profit, dealt with after the last line, in the notes

questions.question: Trade and other receivables include debtors shown at:
options: R53 200 — R56 000 less the R2 800 provision for bad debts

questions.question: The Thebe Bank loan appears under non-current liabilities at:
options: R138 000 — the closing balance with the year's capitalised interest already inside it

questions.question: Total equity and liabilities equals R995 550, which must equal:
options: Total assets of R995 550 — the accounting equation, published

questions.question: An item is classified as CURRENT when it:
options: Turns into cash or falls due within twelve months

questions.question: Land and buildings carry no depreciation because:
options: Land does not wear out, and historical cost keeps it at cost

questions.question: Vehicles: cost R240 000, accumulated depreciation at the start R109 600, current depreciation R48 000. Closing carrying value is:
options: R82 400 — cost less closing accumulated depreciation of R157 600

questions.question: The three closing carrying values — R480 000, R82 400 and R57 600 — must add to:
options: R620 000, the fixed assets figure on the face of the statement

questions.question: The note states the depreciation policy in words because:
options: Consistency demands the same method year after year, and readers must know which method the figures obey

subtopics.title: The Notes: Capital, Current Accounts and the Principles

questions.question: The capital accounts note shows no movement this year because:
options: Fixed capital moves only on a formal decision, and none was made

questions.question: De Waal's opening balance in the current accounts note is shown as:
options: A negative R5 400, because he owed the business at the start of the year

questions.question: The closing balances of R36 200 and R29 600 in the current accounts note connect to the face as:
options: The R65 800 current accounts line inside owners' equity

subtopics.title: The Highlights Reel and the Team Photo

questions.question: The highlights reel and the team photo stand for:
options: The income statement covering the year, and the financial position statement freezing one day
Two versions of the same statement

questions.question: The photo rule says:
options: The photo must be taken monthly
Both lines must be the same height — R995 550 owned, R995 550 claimed

questions.question: A business needs BOTH statements because:
options: One is for the bank and one for SARS
Each is blind to what the other sees — profit says nothing about paying next month's bills, and a fat balance might be borrowed
They contain the same information twice

subtopics.title: The Fine Print That Shows the Workings

questions.question: The relationship between the face and the notes is:
options: Face for the conclusion, note for the proof — and they must meet to the rand
The face repeats the notes in full

questions.question: The fixed assets note climbs to R620 000 by adding:
options: R480 000 plus R82 400 plus R57 600 — the closing carrying values

questions.question: The face shows debtors at R53 200 rather than R56 000 because:
options: R2 800 was received after year end
The R2 800 provision dims the figure to what will honestly be collected

questions.question: The capital note being boring — no movement all year — demonstrates:
options: That planted money is supposed to stand still, and the note publicly confirms it did
That the note was completed wrongly

questions.question: De Waal's column runs from minus R5 400 through earnings of R217 000 and drawings of R182 000 to close at:
options: Plus R29 600 — out of the red, with the business owing him

questions.question: Publishing the opening debit balance rather than hiding it reflects:
options: Honest disclosure — the statements hide nothing, in the spirit of prudence and faithful presentation
